static_traits.name: Meng Jie
static_traits.social_status: Positive relationships with friends who appreciate his work, but self-doubt affects his view of feedback
static_traits.medical_history: No history of major physical illness; no prior psychotherapy or counseling; no similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude; other items not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I am troubled by doubt and pessimism about my comic creation. Despite positive feedback from friends, I still feel no one will publish my work.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts are hindering my creative process and making me doubt my abilities. I hope to stop feeling this way, enjoy painting again, and submit my work for publication with more confidence.

special_situations.event: 当考虑向出版社投稿时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am rejected, it means I am not good enough and not worth publishing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing or postponing submissions, trying to ignore or distract attention to avoid discomfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not人会出版我的作品

special_situations.event: When completing a new comic and preparing to submit it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One rejection equals total failure, proving I am fundamentally not qualified to be published
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced motivation to create, avoiding submission to prevent rejection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I am rejected this time, it means I am not good enough

special_situations.event: When receiving positive feedback from friends about the work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' positive feedback is unreliable, cannot serve as evidence that I am capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Questioning and downplaying positive evaluation, continuing to focus on possible negative outcomes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是出于礼貌在夸我

special_situations.event: Whenever starting to create a new comic work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must ensure there will be no rejection, otherwise one should not continue creating
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: During the creative process, constantly attends to potential rejection information, ignoring neutral or positive signs
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我只看得到被拒的可能

core_conflict.wish: Longing for one's work to be recognized and published, gaining affirmation of self-worth and ability
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected by the publisher, and viewing rejection as negation of one's own worth
defense_goal: Reduces anxiety and protects self-esteem by avoiding submissions and ignoring / distracting from negative thoughts

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable creator who is easily negated
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges/publishers who may reject oneself

object_relations.self_representation: A creator who harbors doubts about one's own ability
object_relations.object_representation: Praisers who are merely being polite (whose feedback is not credible)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to examine the thought 'if I am rejected it means I am not good enough', or to discuss submission plans
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences examining negative beliefs as threatening, worrying about exposing own shortcomings and being negated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: The client tends to use brief statements such as 'I try not to think about it' to downplay topics and avoid describing feelings in detail; when pressed further, the client turns to discussing technical and procedural topics (such as the market and submission processes), lowering the emotional intensity, with a cautious tone.

manifestations: Difficulty opening up to supportive friends about self-doubt regarding publishing

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Views potential rejection as a total negation of self-worth
In sessions, frequently emphasizes worries about 'not being good enough'
Hesitating to submit, overly caring about others' evaluation and questioning friends' positive feedback

positive_force: Has a strong passion for comics (creating is the center of his life)
Has a supportive group of friends who often give positive feedback
In other areas (such as job hunting) has previously been able to view rejection more objectively; has transferable coping resources
negative_force: Catastrophic fortune telling: firmly believes 'no one will publish it'
Dismisses positive feedback, focuses excessively on possible rejection
Overgeneralization and personalization: equating a single rejection with total failure and attributing it to oneself not being good enough
Finds it hard to open up self-doubt to friends, so the support network is hard to fully utilize

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding submissions, decline in creative motivation, accompanied by significant anxiety and self-doubt
antecedent: 完成作品并准备提交时
target_behavior.core_reason: Equates potential rejection with not being good enough personally, catastrophically predicts 'it will not be published', and filters out positive feedback
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible rejection and damage to self-worth, temporarily reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Delays or does not submit works, creation is blocked, overall mood is low and stress increases
